metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) over Los Angeles lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 (tropospheric column) for Los Angeles (≈34°N, 118°W) for 1–23 Oct 2018, 2019, 2021. 2. Masking: Tropospheric NO2 is single-band (tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density); quality flag qa_value ≥ 0.75 keeps only high-quality pixels. 3. Logic: Compute mean NO2 for each year inside a ~50 km box over LA; compare 2021 to 2018 & 2019. If valid pixels =0 → C2; if result is None/NaN → C3; else A (lower) or B (not lower). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Period la = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2, 34.05]).buffer(50000) year_list = [2018, 2019, 2021] period = ['-10-01', '-10-24'] results = {} # 2. Process each year for yr in year_list: col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterBounds(la) .filterDate(f'{yr}{period[0]}', f'{yr}{period[1]}') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filter(ee.Filter.gte('qa_value', 0.75))) n_img = col.size().getInfo() if n_img == 0: print(f'{yr} images: 0') print('C1') exit() img = col.mean().clip(la) count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=la, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'] mean_no2 = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=la, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'] if mean_no2 is None or count == 0: print(f'{yr} valid pixels: 0') print('C2') exit() results[yr] = mean_no2 print(f'{yr} Images: {n_img}, NO2: {mean_no2:.3e}, Pixels: {int(count)}') # 3. Compare lower = (results[2021] < results[2019]) and (results[2021] < results[2018]) print('A' if lower else 'B') ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Period
la = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2, 34.05]).buffer(50000)
year_list = [2018, 2019, 2021]
period = ['-10-01', '-10-24']
results = {}

# 2. Process each year
for yr in year_list:
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
             .filterBounds(la)
             .filterDate(f'{yr}{period[0]}', f'{yr}{period[1]}')
             .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
             .filter(ee.Filter.gte('qa_value', 0.75)))
    n_img = col.size().getInfo()
    if n_img == 0:
        print(f'{yr} images: 0')
        print('<answer>C1</answer>')
        exit()
    img = col.mean().clip(la)
    count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=la, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density']
    mean_no2 = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=la, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density']
    if mean_no2 is None or count == 0:
        print(f'{yr} valid pixels: 0')
        print('<answer>C2</answer>')
        exit()
    results[yr] = mean_no2
    print(f'{yr} Images: {n_img}, NO2: {mean_no2:.3e}, Pixels: {int(count)}')

# 3. Compare
lower = (results[2021] < results[2019]) and (results[2021] < results[2018])
print('<answer>A</answer>' if lower else '<answer>B</answer>')
